criteria.name: Identity, footprint, and local frame
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 528 is the feature identity. The reopened base mesh agrees with the same simplified polygon to about 2.24 micrometres, and the asset root transform is identity. This checks coordinate construction against the source polygon, not a separate wall survey or master placement.

criteria.name: Vertical massing, connector, and roof
criteria.evidence: The asset presents eight residential levels and a low north dining/link portion consistent with broad Purdue program and site-plan evidence. The partition, endpoint, absolute height, floor rhythm, and roof assembly remain estimated or unverified; the roof remains a simple plane with restrained seam detail.

criteria.name: Facade, entrance, and materials
criteria.evidence: The brick/window language, glazed lower level, varied window widths, and added multistory glazed bay are more source-informed than R1. The 2026 construction image shows a more recessed/open atrium stack with visible structure; R2 models this as a simpler glazed bay, with its placement not georegistered. The window rhythm and overall facade remain schematic.

criteria.name: Interior and amenities
criteria.evidence: The R2 ground-floor diagram links entry, lobby/dining, and game/lounge zones with continuous circulation and clips floor patches to the GIS envelope. The cutaway still reads as a diagram with large blank areas; partitions, doors, stairs/cores, and vertical circulation are not legible. Exact room locations are unsupported by the available sources.

criteria.name: Source evidence and uncertainty
criteria.evidence: The build record preserves Purdue GIS identity/raw response, CRS, the Trustees site plan, university housing sources, and construction imagery with dates and explicit limitations. It distinguishes envelope agreement from structural-wall accuracy and marks the height, facade, connector, and interior assumptions.

criteria.name: Saved asset and portability
criteria.evidence: Independent Blender 5.2.3 fresh reopen matched the expected SHA-256. The expected collection/root are present, root is identity, the 24 meshes have materials, and there are no external file-backed images. Master placement was not part of this asset review.

findings: R2 makes a substantial, source-informed improvement to the exterior with a multistory glazed bay and less uniform window widths.
The residential mass and low dining/link arm remain plausible broad forms; their internal partition and vertical dimensions are not surveyed.

The continuous public-area route fixes the prior disconnected-sample presentation and its polygons are constrained to the GIS outline, but the cutaway remains schematic rather than an architectural floor plan.
The atrium, roof/eaves, and facade still differ from available reference imagery or lack sufficiently detailed evidence.
The standalone asset passes at 8.2/10; the coordinator must still validate its master placement marker and full-master integration.
limitations: The asset base was generated from the same Purdue GIS FID 528 polygon used for the outline comparison; this is not an independent wall survey.
The Trustees site plan is not georeferenced; the residential/dining split and connector endpoint are approximate.
GIS floor fields have no documented units or verified vertical datum; height and floor-to-floor dimensions are estimates.
Construction imagery supports a multistory atrium cue but does not establish its georeferenced facade location, as-built dimensions, or final construction condition.
No room-by-room floor plan or interior circulation/core source was located; public-space arrangement and amenities are schematic.
The complete campus master and `Placement_south_hall` marker were not reviewed.
